energy_convention: Measured electronic Hamiltonian expectation plus PySCF nuclear repulsion exactly once equals total molecular energy (Hartree).
observable_layout_step: The script calls system.qubit_hamiltonian.apply_layout(isa_circuit.layout) after ISA transpilation, so Pauli observables address the physical qubits used by the circuit.

requested_estimator_options.mitigation_note: Level 0 requests no Runtime error mitigation/suppression. Higher levels must be interpreted from the returned Runtime metadata and may add measurement or ZNE work.

submission_safety: This record is not a hardware result unless hardware_execution is true and a completed job result is present. The script submits only with --submit and an explicit --backend.
